about: When a broker token is traded again, as both clients of the secrets broker work it out: the Go client of packages/envoy/internal/cipherclient (renewalAt) and the TypeScript client of packages/cipher-client (renewalAt in src/token-client.ts). Each suite reads this one file and replays every row through its own rule, so neither client's renewal drifts from the other's.

The rule: a token is traded again renew_before_seconds ahead of its expiry, and never before half of what it had left when it landed; a token already past its expiry is traded again at once. So a token of at least twice the window renews the window ahead of its expiry, and a shorter one at its half life.
life_seconds is what the token has left when it lands, and renews_after_seconds is how long after it lands the rule trades again. Times are seconds, and a half second is written as one.
